about: Candidates, not yet creatures: fifty new kinds put together from kit parts by rule (tools/kitgen/candidates.py), for Zac to pick from. Ten plans, five of each; a plan is a silhouette the bestiary's six orders do not have. Each candidate is a recipe in the format kit-creatures.json uses (part ids and placements on a 400-wide canvas, centre line x = 200; every placement is free, with its mirror image written beside it), so a picked one moves there unchanged. Names are working names.

plans.rule: Two spines side by side under one head, held together by bridges.
A crescent: two horns reaching forward round an open middle.
One trunk that splits into several necks, a head on each.
Wide storeys stacked on a mast, each wider than the one above.
A head between two horns that wind in on themselves.
The same above as below: a head at both ends.
A long beam held crosswise, a weight at each end and pendants beneath.
A colony: many small bodies held in a net.
Arms that all lean the same way round a hub: it turns instead of mirroring.
Two legs joined by a span overhead, with room to pass beneath.
